profile.summary: An insurance company based in Mission Viejo, California, founded in 1970. It designs and administers student accident and sickness insurance plans for public and private schools, community colleges and other educational institutions, including catastrophic injury coverage.

review.notes: Same organization (name, Mission Viejo location and student accident insurance services all match the agenda). However the summary calls it 'an insurance company', while its own site describes it as a licensed broker/administrator (insurance MGA/TPA) and explicitly not an insurer, so the summary mischaracterizes it; it should be redone as a broker/administrator.
